bull_bear.body:
- Both announced expansions are to be financed by "Bank Loan and Own Funds" / "bank loans & internal accruals"; total announced capex is stated by the deck as Rs 37 Cr.
- Company describes an "Asset-light model" and "Scalability: Enables rapid expansion with low capital expenditure", alongside the Rs 37 Cr capacity capex programme.
- Listed on NSE SME in 2024 with an issue size of Rs. 30.24 Cr, with the IPO oversubscribed by more than 260 times.
- Sunlite Aluminium Private Limited (wholly owned subsidiary) is stated to bring income tax benefits, capital subsidy and interest subsidy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Established in 2012, specializes in manufacturing diverse copper products from recycled scrap at its state-of-the-art plant in Kheda, Gujarat, with scrap sourced from the domestic market as well as imports including from Saudi Arabia, UAE and USA.
- Deck states a "Pure B2B Model: 100% B2B with stable, high-volume contracts" with a "Diversified Revenue Base: Top 20 clients account for ~50% of revenue, ensuring stable cash flows with no dependency on any single customer".
- "Competitive Moat: Quality approvals create barriers for new entrants"; ISO 9001:2015 QMS certification assessed by International Certification & Inspection UK Ltd; footprint across 10+ Indian states & U.T.
- "Strategic Physical Hedging": physical hedging (material-to-material) of copper is described as stabilizing margins against commodity price volatility and delivering predictable profitability.
- Global presence slide lists USA, UK, Europe, Israel, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, South Africa, Malaysia and Australia.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] 2026 milestone: acquisition of Sunlite Aluminium Private Limited (SAPL), a wholly owned subsidiary, integrating aluminium recycling into operations and expanding capabilities in the aluminium sector.
- [Corporate history] Formerly known as Sunlite Alucop Private Limited; converted from partnership firm to private limited company in 2022; crossed revenue of Rs. 1,000 crore in 2023.
- [Governance] Board is promoter-family led: Akshay Kumar Heda (Chairman & Non-Executive Director), Nitin Kumar Heda (Managing Director), Manish Kumar Heda (Director & CFO), Prahladrai Ramdayal Heda (Whole time Director), Khushboo Heda (Non-Executive Director).
- [Industry] Deck cites India's domestic copper consumption at approximately 1.88 million tons as of early 2026 with YoY growth of about 9.3% to 10%, FY26 India copper demand projected to grow 10-12% annually, and a GoI target of 500 GW non-fossil fuel-based energy capacity by 2030 (Source: Copper India, India EV, IBEF).
- [IR] Presentation prepared with KAPTIFY Consulting (Strategy & Investor Relations).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Sunlite Recycling Industries as a Kheda, Gujarat-based copper-scrap recycler running a fully integrated Scrap to Rod to Wire to Busbar/Strips model, now forward-integrating into value-added ATC and busbars and adding aluminium recycling through a wholly owned subsidiary.
